                      --session-id SESSION_ID
                      [--session-turn-id SESSION_TURN_ID]
                      agent_id

positional arguments:
  agent_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session-transport SESSION_TRANSPORT
  --session-id SESSION_ID
  --session-turn-id SESSION_TURN_ID
